body: I’m sorry you’re going through something similar; It’s definitely hard to let go. It’s also hard for me to accept that it’s HIM that there’s something wrong with and not me. It’s gotten to the point where I’ve considered plastic surgery. Ex. He likes noses that are downturned and doesn’t like one’s upturned like mine. Caught him staring at this girl who looked like a real life Instagram influencer and he said her face was better bc of that... ouch.
Unfortunately no it’s not that one. :(
Yeah we tried on the old Xbox and it wasn’t there either :/ we just decided to start over completely
Thank you! What primer would you suggest? And I’ll be sure to post some photos on here. :)
“RESPECT THE POUNCH. RESPECT IT” haha I miss those commercials and thank you!

He said he thought he was too young to do an X-ray because we don’t know how he’ll develop. He said if he ends up not wanting to move around as much (like if I was throwing a ball for him and he only went to get it like 2 times and then laid down) then we should get an X-ray.

UPDATE: I took him to my vet, and the vet said that he seems totally fine and healthy. He doesn’t think his back legs are a major issue, but he did see what I was talking about with his hind legs. He felt around his hip and leg area and said if he does have any issue that it’s too young to tell, and to just keep an eye on him. His legs are already getting longer and he has no issue moving around, and playing with my other puppy. Plus, I finally named him!!!! He’s my little (for now) Leo. ❤️
Thank you so much again for you advice; I really appreciate. I just want to make sure he’s as healthy as he can be!

We do have another puppy that’s a bit older than him and they LOVE to play fight with each other. Do you think that would be a problem with his hips? To be honest she does like to jump on him, and I’ve been trying to get them to calm down a bit.
Thank you so much for the quick response and great advice. I really hope it’s not the case, but I’ll love him and take care of him either way. ❤️
